title: Best Portable Monitors 2025: Work From Anywhere
subtitle: Top picks for remote workers and digital nomads
author: Technova Team
content:
In 2025, portable monitors have become essential tools for remote workers, digital nomads, and anyone who needs a second screen on the go. Whether you're working from a coffee shop, traveling for business, or just need extra screen real estate at home, a portable monitor can dramatically boost your productivity.

We've tested dozens of portable monitors to find the best options across different categories and budgets. Here are our top picks for 2025.

Best Overall: ASUS ZenScreen MB16ACV

>

The ASUS ZenScreen MB16ACV remains our top pick for 2025. This 15.6-inch Full HD IPS display delivers exceptional color accuracy and brightness in a slim, lightweight package weighing just 1.76 lbs.

Key Specs:

  • Display: 15.6

Full HD (1920x1080) IPS
  • Brightness: 300 nits
  • Response Time: 5ms
  • Connectivity: USB-C, mini-HDMI
  • Weight: 1.7 lbs (770g)

    • Pros: Affordable price, dual USB-C ports, includes protective case, built-in speakers

    Cons: Plastic build feels less premium, stand could be sturdier

Buying Guide: What to Consider

Resolution

Full HD (1920x1080) is sufficient for most users and provides the best balance of image quality and power consumption. Choose 4K if you do professional creative work or want maximum clarity.

Connectivity

USB-C with DisplayPort Alt Mode is the most convenient option for modern laptops. HDMI provides broader compatibility. Look for models with multiple options for maximum flexibility.

Portability

Weight matters when traveling. Most 15.6-inch portable monitors weigh between 1.5-2 lbs. Consider included cases and stands as part of your portability assessment.

Power

Some portable monitors can be powered entirely through USB-C from your laptop, while others need separate power. Check your laptop's power output capabilities before purchasing.

Final Verdict

For most users, the ASUS ZenScreen MB16ACV offers the best combination of image quality, build quality, and portability. Budget-conscious buyers should consider the Lepow Z1, while creative professionals will appreciate the UPERFECT 4K's stunning resolution. If touch input is essential, the ViewSonic TD1655 is the clear choice.

Whichever you choose, a portable monitor is a worthwhile investment that can transform how you work on the go.
